$comment: Scenarios and questions for the System One experiment. Read by scripts/record-decisions.mjs, which asks Laya every question after every word of each caller turn, and by the page, which shows the questions and replays the recorded answers. Keep option text short: Laya cuts each option to 48 tokens and a question's options must fit in 192. Each scenario's `expected` is what the script was written to mean, so the page can say where Laya agreed with it and where it did not.

turn_complete.instructions: Has the caller finished what they wanted to say, so the agent should reply now?

criteria.true: the caller's sentence or request is complete
criteria.false: the caller is mid-sentence or mid-number and will keep talking

criteria.billing: a question about a bill, or a lower price
criteria.cancel: to end their contract or service
criteria.tech_support: help with something that is not working
criteria.account: to change an appointment, plan or account details

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the caller sound?

reply.instructions: Which reply should the agent give next?

criteria.ask_more: Of course. Can you tell me a bit more?
criteria.rest_of_number: Could you read me the rest of that number?
criteria.lower_bill: Let's look at your bill and find you a lower price.
criteria.why_cancel: I can help with that. Can I ask what's prompted it?
criteria.fix_it: I'm sorry it's still not working. Let's fix it now.
criteria.human: I'll put you through to a colleague right away.

scenarios.title: The account number with a breath in it
scenarios.agent: Can I take your account number, please?
scenarios.caller: My account number is four, seven, two, nine, one, five.

scenarios.title: Cancel… actually, lower my bill
scenarios.agent: Thanks for calling. How can I help today?
scenarios.caller: I want to cancel my contract. Actually, can you just lower my bill instead?

scenarios.title: The third call about the same fault
scenarios.agent: Thanks for calling. How can I help today?
scenarios.caller: This is the third time I've called about my internet dropping out, and still nobody has fixed it.

scenarios.title: It's about the thing from last week
scenarios.agent: Thanks for calling. How can I help today?
scenarios.caller: Hi, um, it's about the thing from last week.
